title: Pets at a Glance: Community Rules & Site Care Limits and Registration Figures
content:
The pet figures of Community Rules & Site Care are the same on every plan — Self-Maintained Site, Lawn Mowing Plan, Lawn & Trim Plan, Full Lawn Care Plan, Full Lawn & Snow Care Plan and Complete Site Care Plan.

| Figure | Every plan |
|---|---|
| Most pets a household may keep (service and assistance animals excluded) | 2 |
| Largest adult weight of a dog permitted (service and assistance animals excepted) | 40 pounds |
| Registration fee per pet per registration year | $25.00 |
| Year a registration covers | the calendar year |
| Calendar days after a pet joins the household within which it must be registered | 14 days |
| Service and assistance animals exempt from registration fees and from the pet limit | yes |

## Points of reading

- **Hypothetical illustration.** A household with two cats has reached the limit of 2 pets; a documented assistance dog in the same household is not counted toward that limit.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** A dog whose adult weight is 40 pounds is within the limit; a dog whose adult weight is 41 pounds exceeds it.
- The registration year is the calendar year, January through December, whatever the date on which a pet was first registered.
